summary.headline: Moon–Mars Sign Conjunctions
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the Moon’s conjunction with Mars in Leo, Virgo, Libra, and Scorpio, describing effects of the conjunction, sextile, square, trine, and opposition on war, armies, weather, roads, prices, rulers, cities, and civil disorder, including Babylon.
